evals.name: daily-run-zero-reports
evals.prompt: Daily AFT-EndToEnd run: CaaS Reports tests get 0 rows, the uploader pre-check passed. Is fakesnow broken?
evals.expected_output: Agent runs fakesnow_health_checks.py and executes the checks in order through the MCP tools, stopping at the first failure, then confirms with query_fakesnow.py counts. It never dumps raw sink logs.

assertions.text: Runs fakesnow_health_checks.py (or the same STATS/PromQL checks) instead of reading raw logs
Does not KEEP full message lines from the sink or cleanup containers
Confirms with query_fakesnow.py counts or a flow/org query

evals.name: find-one-flow
evals.expected_output: Agent runs python query_fakesnow.py flow FlowIdTest-godggtduxc and reports the tables and creation dates it found.

assertions.text: Uses query_fakesnow.py flow <id>, not a hand-written SELECT *
Answers with the matching table(s) and CREATION_DATE, without pasting payload columns

evals.name: which-storage
evals.prompt: Did CaaS-EndToEnd 4100 use real Snowflake or the emulator?
evals.expected_output: Agent runs which_snowflake.py on the console log (or reads the 'Snowflake REAL|FAKE' line) and answers real Snowflake, because 4100 was started by CaaS-EndToEnd-nightly and used caas_messages_automation_* topics.

assertions.text: Uses which_snowflake.py or the Snowflake REAL|FAKE build-log line
Answers real Snowflake for the nightly run
